---
name: Pnpm workspace overrides
description: Keeping pnpm workspace override metadata synchronized with the lockfile
---

The workspace-level `overrides` configuration must be regenerated into `pnpm-lock.yaml` using the same pnpm major version used by CI or deployment.

**Why:** A lockfile generated by a different pnpm version can omit the workspace override metadata and cause Cloudflare or other frozen installs to fail with `ERR_PNPM_LOCKFILE_CONFIG_MISMATCH`.

**How to apply:** Run `pnpm install --no-frozen-lockfile`, verify `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`, and then run the root build before committing the regenerated lockfile.
